## Summary and General Analysis
- Pela's Ultimate applies DEF Reduction to all enemies for 2 turns.
- Her Talent allows her for more frequent Ultimates when she attack enemies she has debuffed.
- Pela’s Skill removes 1 buff from the targeted enemy.

## Notable Investments
 ### E2, E4
- E2 increases her SPD after dispelling 1 buff from the targeted enemy.
- E4 enables her Skill to reduce the target enemy’s Ice RES for 2 turns.

## Ability Rotation
- Basic ATK spam, Skill if needed
